function: F-06.1 — Alert to order arrival: make the pilot aware that a new order has arrived and demands attention (satisfied by the existing notification framework). F-06.2 — Present order content for comprehension: render the received orders so the pilot can understand what is being tasked (satisfied by the system storing and ordering received notifications into an order list). F-06.3 — Preserve/persist the order for later reference: retain each order's full content so it remains re-consultable after initial delivery (satisfied by the system storing received notifications, shown as order details).
function_summary: Order notification, display, and persistence for pilots
behaviour: Be-06.1.1 (Screen + Audio-out, reused): on order receipt the system raises the existing R02 multi-channel alert — persistent notification strip entry plus audio ping; pressing the notification opens the order (framework-owned). Be-06.2.1 (Screen): the system stores each received order and renders them as an ordered, enumerated list by arrival time/priority, output-only. Be-06.3.1 (Screen): the system retains each stored order's full content and renders its details on demand (opened via out-of-scope input), sharing the same stored-order data as the list.
behaviour_summary: Order receipt alerts, ordered list, and on-demand details.
structure: S-06.1.1.1 (reused): R02 notification framework — WAD notification strip entry (Screen) + cockpit audio ping (Audio-out), carrying the order-typed payload, no new build. S-06.2.1.1: Order List overlay panel (WAD, Screen) — scrollable list, each row = timestamp + title, ordered by arrival/priority, output-only. S-06.2.1.2: HUD order-count/summary line (HUD, Screen) — heads-out complement showing count + latest order type, full list stays on WAD. S-06.3.1.1: Order Details view (WAD, Screen) — selecting a list row renders the order's full content, sharing the stored-order data with S-06.2.1.1 (one panel, list↔detail states, one order store).
structure_summary: Order notification, list, summary, and detail display system
